instruction: A clean studio photograph in a wide eye-level medium-full shot shows a group of cheerleaders standing in a line against a plain white backdrop with vertical light bars. From left to right, the wavy light brown-haired woman (R5), the blonde woman (R2), the dark-haired woman (R13), the straight brown-haired woman (R8), the curly-haired woman (R1) in the center, the purple-haired woman (R7), the short black-haired woman (R12), the long brown-haired woman (R9), and the long dark brown-haired woman (R14) stand side-by-side. All wear matching white t-shirts with a "Warsaw Mets" logo and white skirts. They stand facing forward with hands on hips, holding orange pom-poms. The scene is brightly lit with a soft purple ambient glow from below.
